subject: Intro + brief demo: verify traffic & go-live window
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen@brightgoods.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Intro: quick demo request + traffic snapshot

Hi Soojin,

Thanks — we self-signed up last week and I was hoping to get a short demo to confirm fit. Very high level context: we run product search and an in-app assistant for BrightGoods (ecommerce). Primary usage will be embeddings search for product recommendations + light chat for help.

Quick numbers:
- Expected monthly queries (embedding lookups + chat prompts): ~300k/month
- Peak concurrency: roughly 80–120 qps during promotions
- Average request size: 120 tokens response, 60 token input
- Target go-live: mid‑March 2027 (aiming for internal pilot in Feb)

Before we book time, can you confirm:
1) Any obvious blockers for that scale on the hosted plan?
2) What info you need from our side to size capacity and demo focus (e.g., concurrency vs. monthly)?
3) Available demo slots next week (we’re PST but flexible evenings)?

I attached a quick traffic CSV export in case it helps.

Thanks,
Ellen
Ellen Park
Head of Product
BrightGoods
ellen@brightgoods.io

Attachment: brightgoods-traffic.csv
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen@brightgoods.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro: quick demo request + traffic snapshot

Hi Ellen — great to see you in the product. Happy to run a focused 30‑minute demo that drills into throughput and the ops controls that matter for a pilot. I looped Ben (AE) to handle calendar and Marcus (SE) to join for a quick technical pre‑brief if useful.

A couple of short prequal Qs so we make the demo actionable:
- Primary flow: embeddings search (vector similarity) or chat-first (LLM + retrieval)? If both, what % split?
- 80–120 qps peak: is that sustained for minutes or bursts for hours (e.g., promotion windows)?
- Latency SLO target (p50/p95) for user-facing requests?
- Any compliance / data residency constraints (EU customers, PII redaction)?
- Are you evaluating cost-sensitive options (quantized model variants / dedicated capacity)?

Proposed demo slots (PST):
- Tue 2026-12-22 09:30–10:00
- Tue 2026-12-22 16:00–16:30 (if later works better)
- Wed 2026-12-23 08:00–08:30 (early option)

I’ve attached a short demo agenda we use for pilots — we’ll tailor it based on your answers. If none of the slots work, Ben will share a Calendly link for alternatives.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Sales Development Representative | Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf
From: Ellen Park <ellen@brightgoods.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 13:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro: quick demo request + traffic snapshot

Thanks Soojin — answers inline:
- Primary flow: embeddings search ~85%, chat 15% (chat mostly for cart assistance).
- Peak: bursts during promotions that last 1–3 hours; sustained for those windows, not days. Recent promo peak CSV attached (timestamps included).
- Latency: we aim for p95 < 400 ms for search. p50 < 120 ms would be great.
- Compliance: no EU customer data in pilot; US-only for now. PII: product metadata only, no customer PII in requests.
- Cost sensitivity: yes, we’re cost-aware but want to prioritize reliability during promos — open to recommendations (quantization, dedicated vs hosted).

Any of the Tue slots work for us, prefer the 16:00 slot (PST). Ben — can you send a calendar invite?

Quick note on procurement: if pilot looks good, we’ll need rough cost estimates by Jan so procurement can budget for March pilot.

Thanks,
Ellen

Attachment: brightgoods-traffic.csv
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen@brightgoods.io>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 17:05:00 -0800

Ellen — thanks for the answers and for the CSV. I’ve booked Tue 2026-12-22 16:00–16:30 PST on the invite (Calendly link: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min?invite=RDW-4821) — invite sent to your calendar. Marcus will join for the first 10 minutes to confirm load patterns and suggested config for the promo windows.

Pre-demo deliverables from our side:
- Short runbook on expected throughput knobs and a pro-forma cost estimate for 300k/mo with 80–120 qps peaks (we’ll send by Tue morning).
- Demo script focusing on: embeddings latency, KV/prefix caching, and fallback model variants.

If you have a sample query or two you’d like us to walk through, paste them into this thread or drop into the attached agenda doc. Looking forward to the conversation.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
